name: Kachiku Shimai
source:
The daughters of a family-owned travel lodge return home to see what they've inherited.

It's very different from what they remember... and somewhere along the way they become sex trainees hog-tied and on display for an obscene scatological show.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE110838.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一家旅行旅馆的女儿们回到家，看看自己继承了什么。

这里与她们记忆中的完全不同……不知不觉间，她们变成了被绑成一团、公开展示、接受淫秽排泄表演训练的性奴。
